That specific verse is just talking about how God made plants for animals and people to have for food.

It frustrates me when Christians add meaning to verses like this, as if they have some special knowledge about the verses that others don't. comments.text:
Speaking of a viral medical case, while not TikTok, there's one case going viral in my country where there's a patient who was talking about waiting 8 hours to get a room. He mentioned that he got our country's universal healthcare, and there's a lot of things to unpack about that, but let's just say due to the corrupt bureaucracy, the universal healthcare that's supposed to be executed well as a win-win solution for patients and medical workers instead becomes a sore point for medical workers here. 

Now, the patient didn't mean anything but just to vent. He was in pain and didn't even name the hospital nor say anything else other than the fact he had waited 8 hours in a hopeless tone. Not even in a complaining tone. But there were a lot of medical workers, mostly doctors, who immediately told him to either move to the morgue, cut his own wrist, told him to shut up, called him not having brain cells, etc. Seven days later, the patient died, his last post being the post where some medical workers told him plainly to go die.

It went viral immediately, and citizens are outraged because these medical workers are supposed to be empathetic. Supposed to abide by the oath they swore when they became a doctor to be empathetic. We weren't expecting them to be saints, angels, we understand that the healthcare system is still far from perfect. But to say those things to a patient who is suffering from their pain? 

Suffice to say netizens are on a hunt. Calling for these medical workers to be fired and all. I don't condone doxxing, I also don't actually condone retribution in the form of harassing them in return. But I just want to spread this story as a form of social sanction for the medical workers. Let the world know of their mistake. May they live forever with their unforgiven sin, as the only person who can forgive them had passed away being harassed by the people supposed to help him.

When I walked my daughter to the bus It was sooo bad that i was stumbling, falling and had a "hangover" type headache (now i havent drank in 13 years at this point).  Finally we went to Urgent Care in the middle of the night, they didnt believe me at first until my psychiatrist and GP explained that i have OCD with ritualistic behaviors with eating, that they finally after everyone communicated and one brilliant nurse concluded I had Auto Brewery syndrome!!
